description: Source code for Wi-Fi endpoint management, including functions for enabling/disabling endpoints, connecting/disconnecting, WPS operations, retrieving stats, and managing interface states within a Wi-Fi driver or management system.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_createHook
methods.description: Initializes the Wi-Fi endpoint, sets up WPA supplicant and event handlers.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_destroyHook
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the Wi-Fi endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the Wi-Fi endpoint and updates STA mode accordingly.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_disconnect
methods.description: Disassociates the endpoint from an access point.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_bssid
methods.description: Retrieves the BSSID (MAC of remote AP) if connected.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_setMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_connectAp
methods.description: Commands the endpoint to connect to a specified access point.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_status
methods.description: Retrieves the interface status of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_update
methods.description: Updates WPA supplicant with new configuration.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_connStatus
methods.description: Gets the current connection status of the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_setMldUnit
methods.description: Configures MLD (Multi-Link Device) unit if supported.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_wpsStart
methods.description: Starts a WPS session with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for the endpoint, including signal, noise, and traffic data.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_multiApEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables multi-AP (multi-access point) mode.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_sendManagementFrame
methods.description: Sends a management frame over the interface.

methods.name: wifiGen_ep_getConnChspec
methods.description: Retrieves the current channel specification for the connection.
